# Recorded variant article metadata

The JSON contains public BioMCP article output and NCBI title and abstract text recorded on 2026-10-23 for `AKT1 E17K`. It retains the first recorded union occurrence of each PMID, recorded route provenance, the literal relevance-sorted PubMed list, and available NCBI abstracts. Missing abstracts remain missing. It contains no clinical labels or curation-team answers.

The provider replay reconstructs finite source lists from recorded provenance and maps those records into provider response shapes. Empty annotation and compatible variant resolution responses are authored transport controls. These controls do not claim validated annotations or CIViC citations. The replay proves ranking over these captured inputs. It does not claim that the recorded source lists exhaust upstream providers.
